title: SessionMcpStatusChanged
description: The MCP servers of a session and where each one stands — the whole list, every time, so a client never patches. An event of the session, with its `seq`: published once the servers the backend composed have been handed to the CLI, after every `session.toggleMcpServer` or `session.reconnectMcpServer` that changed something, and when a server is switched off because its configuration was removed or switched off (tightening applies at once). A client that does not know it ignores it.

name.description: As configured — text a person wrote, to be escaped before display.

status.description: `needs-auth` asks for a browser on the machine (OAuth); no OAuth address ever travels through the product.

source.description: Where the definition came from, read off the SDK's `source` and never off the name: `ours` is a server of the store, `project` an approved entry of `.mcp.json` (both reach the CLI as `dynamic`), `plugin` one a plugin brought, `other` anything else — never trusted as ours.

error.description: Why it failed, redacted — a URL with a token in it never reaches a client. Absent unless `failed`.
